newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end easier, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end easier, seen stable.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates finished a little weaker on Monday in sufficient liquidity, dealers said.
Overnight rates finished at 19.75 percent after trading around this level all day. The closing price compares to offers of 20 percent at opening and to Friday's close of 20 percent.

Dealers said they did not expect the current rate levels to ease substantially on Tuesday, the last day of the current two-week reserve period, saying banks would then prefer to put money in the central bank's one-week reverse repo facility.

"I expect this (19.75 percent) level to remain on Tuesday or perhaps to ease to 19.50 percent," said Karoly Barath of Postabank. "If it falls more, banks would prefer to put money in reverse repo," he said.
The central bank's one-week reverse repo stands at 20 percent.
